Steps for staff briefings
This article is for anyone travelling with a pet
Companion Animal Travel Desk: booking and check-in guidance

Aurelia Skyways uses the Companion Animal Travel Desk to coordinate pet travel from booking through pickup. The goal is simple: keep the process clear, keep the animal comfortable, and keep communication prompt and respectful. A passenger coordinator will guide you through the steps and note any care needs tied to species, temperament, or travel style.

When you begin, share the basic details the team needs so the booking can move ahead smoothly. <<FACT F091>> Keep your messages direct and timely, since the desk may need to confirm space, crate readiness, or special handling before your trip is secured. If your plans change, let the team know as soon as possible so the file stays accurate.

Before check-in, review the travel plan and make sure your pet is ready for the journey. <<FACT F086>> Bring the items that support comfort and safety, and make sure your container is secure, clean, and suitable for the animal inside it. If the pet is nervous, let the coordinator know early so the team can plan a calmer handoff.

At the airport, follow staff directions closely and keep the pet under control at all times. The Companion Animal Travel Desk can also explain what happens after arrival, including pickup steps and any post-flight care notes that apply to your itinerary. If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways for direct support.
